This routine is used to add a new deficiency to the DEFICIENCY file (#393.3).

Before adding a new record, prompts are displayed to gather the following values:
- DGJTABR (the deficiency abbreviation)
- DGJTCTG (the deficiency category)
- DGJTTRK (whether the deficiency is tracked)
- DGJTSTD (whether the deficiency is considered a standard)
